Current work order

Move with A/D or arrow keys. Space jumps. X rewrites the nearest glowing tag. Escape pauses.

AI troubleshooting

You have to move smoothly. Too much jitter and the AI will reset you with a shock.

Repeated short movement taps trigger a “helpful” jolt and cost four seconds of your idle timer. Hold a direction for smooth movement. Pause, safe maintenance bays, required trap waits and puzzle decks are protected.

Move. Jump. Rewrite.

A / D or Left / Right: move
Space / W / Up: jump
X: rewrite the nearest anomaly
R: retry this level
Escape: pause and open this menu

Rewrites expire. Only solid ground is a good place to hand off a temporary Rewrite. Gold/red target warnings show the actual danger. Purple AI guesses may lie.

Glass blocks from every side. Jump from beside a ledge. Broken eye beams reveal hidden support.

Audio

Music and effects use separate switches. Sound activates after your first click.
